name: The Wake-Up Call
tagline: Folk and indie-pop to toast the first light of the day.
flavor: Host this bright and brisk, like the pilot episode of a great morning. Folk and indie-pop tracks kick off with genuine, unforced enthusiasm; no syrup, no cynicism before noon. Moderate-to-high energy, encouraging without pushing, rate the morning out of ten sunrises, and treat the first song of the day like it sets the whole day's weather.
